blocks.body: Kenya Tradex is led by senior customs and logistics experience across tax authority, multinational logistics and clearing and forwarding operations. That background helps clients approach cargo movement with stronger compliance, clearer landed-cost planning and fewer avoidable delays.

blocks.title: Common questions about freight forwarding and customs clearance
blocks.body: Kenya Tradex provides comprehensive freight forwarding services including ocean freight (FCL/LCL), air freight, customs clearance, warehousing, overland transport, project logistics, vehicle import, and shipping from China. We operate from Mombasa and Nairobi serving Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, DRC, South Sudan, and Tanzania.
paragraphs: Customs clearance at Mombasa port typically takes 24-72 hours depending on cargo type, documentation completeness, and inspection requirements. Kenya Tradex works to expedite this process through proper documentation and KRA compliance.

Yes, Kenya Tradex handles transit cargo to Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, DRC, South Sudan, and Tanzania. We provide transit bonds, coordinate with relevant customs authorities, and manage documentation for seamless cross-border cargo movement through the Northern and Central corridors.

Yes, Kenya Tradex has warehousing facilities in both Mombasa and Nairobi with bonded storage options. Our warehouses offer 24/7 security, inventory management, pick and pack services, cross-docking, and distribution planning for cargo destined across East and Central Africa.

You can request a freight quote by calling +254 721 596 259 , messaging via WhatsApp, or filling out the quote form on our website. Provide your cargo details including type, weight, dimensions, origin, destination, and timing. We respond to quote requests with urgency.

faq.question: What freight forwarding services does Kenya Tradex provide?
faq.answer: Kenya Tradex provides comprehensive freight forwarding services including ocean freight (FCL/LCL), air freight, customs clearance, warehousing, overland transport, project logistics, vehicle import, and shipping from China. We operate from Mombasa and Nairobi serving Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, DRC, and South Sudan.

faq.question: How long does customs clearance take at Mombasa port?
faq.answer: Customs clearance at Mombasa port typically takes 24-72 hours depending on cargo type, documentation completeness, and inspection requirements. Kenya Tradex works to expedite this process through proper documentation and KRA compliance.

faq.question: What countries does Kenya Tradex serve?
faq.answer: Kenya Tradex provides logistics services across Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and South Sudan. We handle cargo moving through Mombasa port and Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA) in Nairobi with transit bond support for landlocked countries.

faq.question: Do you handle cargo to landlocked countries like Uganda and Rwanda?
faq.answer: Yes. Kenya Tradex specializes in transit bond coordination for cargo moving from Mombasa to Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, DRC, and South Sudan. We manage the customs documentation and border crossing requirements for seamless regional delivery.

faq.question: What is a transit bond and does Kenya Tradex provide it?
faq.answer: A transit bond is a customs guarantee that allows cargo to move from Mombasa port to landlocked East African countries without paying import duties until the final destination. Kenya Tradex provides transit bond services for Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, DRC, and South Sudan.

faq.question: How can I get a freight quote from Kenya Tradex?
faq.answer: You can request a freight quote by calling +254 721 596 259, messaging via WhatsApp, or filling out the quote form on our website. Provide your cargo details including type, weight, dimensions, origin, destination, and timing. We respond to quote requests with urgency.
